author: BoldAndBrash
body:
Creators: Zerkk & Eako

Contributors: 07SilverWolf & iRapGod

Pictures: http://imgur.com/a/onazh

YAML: soon.

Download: soon.

Stuff: A map I was working on months ago. I got the download for it and it was gathering dust, so I decided to start working on it again. I made this map particularly for gameplay, but I added some aesthetics to the towers too along with Zerkk. All teams spawn in the same room, but have a white glass barrier so they don't spawnkill each other. The map is pretty big and good for PvP. Also, you can't break blocks on it. Lastly, something that makes the map really unique in my opinion. is being able to fight in the sky tunnels. Opinions are appreciated. Also, sorry for the bad screenies. I was in a rush. :P

Personal ratings: Uniqueness: 4.7/5
                            Aesthetics: 3.1/5
                            Gameplay: 3.5/5

PS: If you want to check it out yourself, it's on Alexanderjoe's build server. The world name is "DaBaderMC#2"
